blender.description: Blender 3D: scene objects, materials, rendering, animation, and addon status checks.

chrome-devtools.description: Control an attached Chrome browser: navigate pages, inspect DOM, analyze network and performance. Disabled by default; enable from /mcp when a task needs a real Chrome.

chrome-devtools-alt.description: Fallback for chrome-devtools: --autoConnect reads the Chrome 144+ remote debugging service via DevToolsActivePort. Needs Full Disk Access for the terminal.

lightpanda.description: Headless browser without Chrome: read pages as markdown or semantic trees, run page JS, click/fill/scroll, cookies, screenshots. See docs/lightpanda.md.
